QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] Frosty Research
QuestInfo.1: Defeat any of the #o8630000#, #o8630001#, #o8630002#, #o8630003#, and #o8630004# enemies in the Forest of Pain and gather #b200 #i4033927# #t4033927##k items.

0.0: Hey, you. Yes, I'm talking to you. You were the kid who wanted to get into the castle, right? I got small favor to ask. You wanna hear me out?

yes.0: All right, straight to the point. I like that.\r\nYou heard of #t4033927#? The frozen weapons drop it sometimes. I want plenty so we can research it, figure out what makes our enemies tick.
yes.1: Now! If you go to #b#m241000215#, #m241000214#, #m241000213#, #m241000212#, or #m241000211##k and eliminate a heap of #b#o8630000#, #o8630001#, #o8630002#, #o8630003#, or #o8630004##k monsters, you'll get #b#t4033927##k items. If you're lucky. I mean, I just need #b200#k.
yes.2: Okay then, eliminate #b#o8630000##k, #b#o8630001##k, #b#o8630002##k, #b#o8630003##k, and #b#o8630004##k monsters and bring back #b200 #t4033927##k items!\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k

no.0: You afraid of a challenge? Fine! Be that way!

1.0: Ooh, did you get them all? Let me see... yes, 200 it is! We need as many as we can get, so I'm going to take all the #t4033927# items you brought. Here is your promised reward.

yes.0: I'll have more work for you from time to time. Come find me when you're free.

default.0: Hey, I told you to collect #t4033927# items. You need way more. Go hunt #b#o8630000#, #o8630001#, #o8630002#, #o8630003#, and #o8630004# monsters,\r\nand collect 200 #i4033927##t4033927# items#k.
